title: Resistome risks of wastewaters and aquatic environments deciphered by shotgun metagenomic assembly
description: In this study, we revealed the core resistome disseminating from hospital wastewater to the aquatic environment by characterizing the trail of resistome, plasmidome, mobilome, and virulome, as well as elucidating their different resistome risks.
